name: Systran/faster-whisper-base
summary: 使用 faster-whisper 的 base 模型将语音转成文字。Systran 的模型卡列出了中文、英语等八种语言，并演示了如何用 faster-whisper 加载模型。
Use the faster-whisper base model to turn speech into text. Systran’s model card lists eight languages, including Chinese and English, and shows how to load the model with faster-whisper.
